title: A Escolha
summary: At 08:15 on 2026-11-07, the full Kairos community votes by secret ballot on proposals from twelve fast-food chains seeking to operate on campus.
keyEvents: All 143 eligible Kairos community members participate in a secret ballot.
The proposal offers optional food access and excludes gambling, alcohol, performance metrics, competitive influence, and individual athlete endorsements.
The proposal limits each person to one use of each restaurant per week and three total fast-food meals per week, enforced through the campus badge.
The policy permits selection of no more than three restaurant chains.
The same policy and Kairos nutritional standards apply to players, coaches, staff, and Adrian Vale.
The result is intentionally withheld until Episode 56.
The vote begins at 08:15 on Saturday, 2026-11-07.
Twelve fast-food chains submit proposals to operate on campus.
consequences: No restaurant partnership, contract, or campus operation is created by the vote alone.
